programme.title: mareTV: Capri and the Amalfi Coast - Italy's Ocean Legends
programme.desc: Capri was already in ancient times a place for the rich and beautiful. Today Capri is one of the most famous islands in the world. Millions of tourists visit it. But there are in fact still unknown corners on the island in the Gulf of Naples. Thus, at the very top of Capri, there is a hermit monastery with a view to the Vesuvius.

programme.title: mareTV: Martinique
programme.desc: The island of Martinique is a piece of France in the Caribbean, between Florida and South America. And of course, Savoir-vivre applies just as it does on the other side of the Atlantic, between the English Channel and the Mediterranean. Jacky Pascault is the first and only man to cultivate mushrooms in the Caribbean. Everywhere else, they grow on artificially fertilised soil, but Jacky's Champignons Tropicaux flourish on sugar cane fibres. Nicole Vilo tailors hats and dresses out of coconut palms. Of course, the catwalk for the models wearing her first collection is one of the countless dream beaches. The Martiniquais sail on boats they call Yole, which have no keel and are therefore difficult to navigate. The crew members hang over the water in breakneck fashion on long wooden poles. Just the job for Yole-boss Max' "problem kids": they not only learn complicated handling, but also team spirit.

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.sub-title: The Psychogramm of a Spiritual Landscape
programme.desc: The Bohemian Forest is the source of the Vltava River, home to primeval forests, untouched high moors and bubbling torrents. This archaic stretch of land, which includes the Bavarian Forest, was long considered impenetrable and mysterious. Since the fall of the Iron Curtain, Bavarian border residents have rediscovered new references to this unusual forest landscape for themselves. This is also the case with photo artist Bastian Kalous, who has been documenting his homeland for years with nostalgic-looking Polaroid photographs and is dealing with its eventful history for an illustrated book. Or Elisa Belotti and Marco Heurich, who have dedicated their lives to the lynxes. In order for Europe's largest wild cat to survive in the Bohemian Forest, the lynx researchers fight for every single animal. Iryna Rudenko came to Zwiesel from Ukraine out of a passion for glass as a material to study at the glass school. After graduation, she would like to stay in Bavaria, Anna Hones grew up in Horská Kvilda, the smallest and highest village in the Czech Republic. The village lies just under 1100 meters above sea level, directly on the former border. The farmer, who experienced communism, the fall of the Iron Curtain and the subsequent changes, is now trying to find ways of surviving in this barren region with her children.

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.desc: Pavel Hubeny, whose life would be unthinkable without the forest, is the head of the Šumava National Park. He is committed to ensuring that a primeval forest can grow for future generations, in which man does not interfere. This vision of a primeval forest is also shared by the forester Claus Bässler, who wants to counteract the extinction of species by having trees felled to create artificial deadwood and thus a new habitat for rare beetles and fungi. On the Vltava River lies the small town of Krumlov, the "Pearl of the Bohemian Forest" with its Baroque theater and fully preserved stage technology from the 17th century. Here the director Zuzana Vrbová enchants people from all over the world with her productions. Apart from agriculture, it was mainly the abundance of forests that ensured the livelihood of the inhabitants of the Bohemian Forest - including that of the carpenter Philipp von Manz, who processed local wood for his customers all over Germany. Veterinarian Judith Gollner, who grew up in the Austrian part of the Bohemian Forest, lived in Vienna for a long time and made a conscious decision to return. She likes the people and is proud of "her farmers' wives" who share her love of the Bohemian Forest.

programme.title: Dust And Stripes
programme.desc: In a never-ending quest for grass and water, the striped herds undertake an annual epic trek across the vast lunar landscape of the Kalahari’s Makgadikgadi Pans. Most of the year, the Makgadikgadi is an inhospitable wasteland of windswept, salt-encrusted pans. For the area’s water-dependent zebra, the Boteti River on the western edge of the pans is a dry-season lifeline. However, it is also a death trap, with lions waiting in ambush and crocodiles lurking in dark riverside caves.

programme.title: mareTV: The Eckernförde Bay - Beach shooters, mine clearance divers, squirrels
programme.desc: Fjord, ford, bay, gulf: there are many names for the beautiful extensions of the Baltic Sea into the country. Eckernförde Bay is shaped by currents, surf and people. It stretches 17 kilometers to the town that gives it its name. Stephan Möller is the acting shooting master of the Eckernförder Bürgerschützengilde. He spent a whole year preparing the beach shooting festival and then this: fog, rain and a stiff breeze. Traditionally, the Eckernförde marksmen always shoot at a wooden bird in the direction of the sea at Whitsun. Under strict conditions! And these stipulate a clear view of at least one kilometer out into the bay. The event literally threatens to fall through, for the first time in 449 years. Around 3,000 soldiers are stationed at the Eckernförde naval base, but only a small group is allowed to call itself an elite unit: the mine divers. They are considered the toughest soldiers in the Navy. Anyone who wants to be one of them has to undergo extreme training. This year, just two candidates made it to the final round. Now they still have to pass the dreaded final exam: running 20 kilometers with marching gear and then swimming ten kilometers through Eckernförde Bay.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.sub-title: On the Ohio River with the “Belle of Louisville”
programme.desc: Idlewild - Avalon - Belle of Louisville - these three names stand for the last still roadworthy, historic sternwheeler in the USA. In 1914, the ship was built as "Idlewild" for the West Memphis Packet Company as a passenger ferry. With a draft of only 1.50 m and a robust steel hull, the boat is suitable for almost all navigable rivers of the Mississippi River system. Today, the "Belle" is the most traveled steamboat in American history. In the course of her eventful life, she has called at 130 places in 19 states.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: The paddle steamer "Skibladner" is the oldest passenger paddle steamer in the world in regular service. It has been plying Norway's largest inland lake, the Mjøsa, since 1856. The "white swan" has a melodious name, borrowed from Norse mythology. The ship "Skíðblaðnir" of the god Freyr, built by dwarves, could always have a tail wind, could be stowed in a small bag when folded and all gods in armor had room on it. The traditional ship of AS Oplandandske Dampskibsselskap does not have such fairy-tale powers, but atmospherically the "Skibladner" also transports guests to a world long gone.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: With a length of more than 1000 kilometers, the Elbe is one of the largest rivers in Europe. The river has shaped landscapes since time immemorial: geologically, economically and culturally. One of the most beautiful sections of the river - in Saxony in southeastern Germany - has been navigated by the Saxon Steamship Company since 1836. One of its most beautiful ships is the Diesbar. Its engine is considered the oldest paddle steamer engine still in use in the world, the ship is the only steamer in the fleet still powered by coal.

programme.title: mareTV: Curacao, Blue Wonder of the Caribbean
programme.desc: Curacao is one of the most popular attractions for countless cruise ships on their trips through the Caribbean, because it is located outside of the hurricane belt. This is why Eric Miguel is constantly in action. He is the bridge keeper of the Queen Emma Bridge, the landmark of Curacao's capital, Willemstad. After his shift, Eric goes to Yvonne Troeman's cook-shop. Her speciality is Kadushi, a cactus soup. The ingredients include cactus flesh, pigtail's, mussels and a few secret "treats". Barbara van Bebber is the only submarine pilot on Curacao and literally gets to the bottom of things amidst the turquoise-blue wonder of the Caribbean. She charters out her sub to marine biologists and wealthy private explorers, simultaneously cleaning up on the seabed. Her "Curasub" has claw arms, which she employs to remove anything that doesn't belong down there: beer bottles, car tyres, and plastic refuse. Jeroen Eikelenboom simply carts sand from a neighbouring cove to his own surf club in his favourite bay.

programme.title: mareTV: Venice - Lagoon and Legend
programme.desc: Venice has been attracting people as if by magic for centuries. The Italians call her La Serenissima, or the sublime. Perched on wooden posts, she braves the elements and the huge, annual surge of visitors. Vogalonga is the name of a Venetian sports competition for women, in which the participants row their boats standing. This is a tradition that Guilia and Elena also follow. They train hard, as the yearly regatta is soon to begin. Anyone caught driving their water vehicle with more than 7 km/h through the canals of Venice, risks getting a ticket from local policewoman Lorenza Mariutti. The reason: the resulting waves gnaw at the foundations of the grand palaces. Venetians are very attached to their traditional cuisine. The island of Sant' Erasmo is the town's garden. Artichokes, radicchio, onions, everything that grows here is said to taste fantastic, thanks to the salt content of the air and water. Carlo and Claudio Finotello not only grow the vegetables, they even deliver directly to their customers' doors. At sunset, they sail through the lagoon with their boat, brimming with produce, towards San Marco. People waiting at the many bridges, now receive their wares: regional, seasonal, fresh. And without a hint of stress if possible. Like so many other things in Venice. Perhaps because La Serenissima is also known as "The Composed".

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Gauja National Park in Latvia features diverse wildlife, red sandstone cliffs and a winding river that flows through forests shaped by long human history.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: The Curonian Spit is a narrow peninsula of dunes and forests shaped by destruction and recovery through careful human intervention.

programme.title: Masai Mara: The Big Hunt
programme.desc: When food supply in the Serengeti dwindles, the Masai Mara is a paradise for predators. As the black wildebeests, gazelles, zebras and antelopes make their yearly trip from the south of the Serengeti to the north, nature’s best laid trap, the Mara River in Kenya is waiting ahead. Captivating shots filmed under water show how crocodiles prepare for the Big Hunt while other predators lurk on the banks awaiting their bounty. The biggest problems for the migratory animals are the Mara and the Tarek River, where they have to put their lives at risk to get to the other side. A great number of them die as they jump into the river and break their legs, while others are carried away by the drift or drown. Those who are not victims of the river itself risk falling prey to the crocodiles. We entered this unchartered territory, the crocodile domain by heading under water. Follow these predators in and around their habitat and watch prides of lions map out their game plan. In slow-motion, we show you the final showdown between predator and prey. Will it be a successful hunt or will the hoofed animals persevere?

programme.title: The Moor
programme.desc: Moors and peatlands are oases in the cultivated landscape of Central Europe.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: The Grand Canyon is a steep-sided canyon carved by the Colorado River in Arizona, United States. The Grand Canyon is 277 miles (446 km) long, up to 18 miles (29 km) wide and attains a depth of over a mile (6,093 feet or 1,857 meters). The canyon and adjacent rim are contained within Grand Canyon National Park, the Kaibab National Forest, Grand Canyon–Parashant National Monument, the Hualapai Indian Reservation, the Havasupai Indian Reservation and the Navajo Nation. President Theodore Roosevelt was a major proponent of preservation of the Grand Canyon area and visited it on numerous occasions to hunt and enjoy the scenery.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yellowstone National Park is an American national park located in the western United States, largely in the northwest corner of Wyoming and extending into Montana, and Idaho. It was established by the U.S. Congress and signed into law by President Ulysses S. Grant on March 1, 1872. Yellowstone was the first national park in the U.S. and is also widely held to be the first national park in the world. The park is known for its wildlife and its many geothermal features, especially Old Faithful geyser, one of its most popular. While it represents many types of biomes, the subalpine forest is the most abundant. It is part of the South Central Rockies forests ecoregion.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: North America’s National Parks are world famous and their breathtaking landscapes fascinate millions of visitors. This spectacular series will show you what happens beyond the lookouts. Everglades National Park is an American national park that protects the southern twenty percent of the original Everglades in Florida. The park is the largest tropical wilderness in the United States, and the largest wilderness of any kind east of the Mississippi River. An average of one million people visit the park each year. Everglades is the third-largest national park in the contiguous United States after Death Valley and Yellowstone. UNESCO declared the Everglades & Dry Tortugas Biosphere Reserve in 1976, and listed the park as a World Heritage Site in 1979, while the Ramsar Convention included the park on its list of Wetlands of International Importance in 1987. Everglades is one of only three locations in the world to appear on all three lists.

programme.title: mareTV: Newfoundland - Canada's Eastern Point
programme.desc: In Newfoundland, at the easternmost tip of North America, the landscape is pristine, dramatic, and very sparsely populated. In summer, icebergs occasionally drift along the steep cliffs. When the "Titanic" collided with an iceberg and sank just 300 miles off the coast of Newfoundland in 1912, the last radio messages were picked up in a small wooden hut on the Avalon Peninsula. Today, most Newfoundlanders live on Avalon. There are particularly many seabirds here. In Witless Bay, the newborn puffins are ready for their first descent into the Atlantic. But some stray onto the coastal road, attracted by the lights of the hotels and restaurants. In doing so, they run the risk of being run over. A team of volunteers saves the lives of countless young birds: The Puffin & Petrel Patrol goes out at night dressed in high-visibility vests to collect the puffins. Biologist Sabrina Wilhelm then brings them back to Green Island, home to the largest puffin colony in North America. Here, the birds catch up on what they should have done long ago: the first dive of their lives.

programme.title: Magical Moors
programme.desc: Wide open heaths, windswept and barren in winter, are transformed into wonderful carpets of white, fluffy cotton grass in summer. Large bears and wolves roam alongside delicately fluttering butterflies, the bubbling calls of black grouse and the enchanting trills of the great snipe. Moors, bogs and wetlands can be found all over in Europe. Everyone has at least heard about this habitat but most know little about it. It is an ancient yet largely unknown set of landscapes that is full of enchanting surprises. On a warm spring day, poisonous adders emerge from hiding to perform their impressive mating dance. As dusk falls, snipe gather on traditional leks, leaping and singing to impress the opposite sex. And deep down in the boggy marshes, glittering emeralds of sticky dew lure insects into the deadly arms of meat-eating plants. Magical Moors captures the quiet beauty of a spectacular landscape, and its often elusive wildlife, in stunning detail.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: It is one of the wildest roads in Asia: the Trans Sulawesi Highway. The adventurous road leads through Indonesia's fourth-largest island and takes people to spectacular destinations. To beautiful beaches, turbulent cities, or unique primeval forests.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Far out in the "Wild West" of Canada lies Bella Coola. If you want to get to the small town on the Pacific, you have no choice: there is only one road leading there, the Bella Coola Highway. It is constantly monitored and yet remains dangerous. Gravel roads, narrow hairpin bends and steep mountain slopes make the highway in British Columbia a particular challenge.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In the extreme north-east of Norway known as the Finnmark region, winters are freezing cold and snowy. Due to the location on the Arctic Ocean, the roads are prone to snow drifts. Every metre is a challenge and a journey into risk. An adventure for all those who set off into the fascinating and unique landscape, through a seemingly endless desert of snow.

programme.title: The most spectacular change of seasons - Spring
programme.desc: This film explores Central Europe and presents the nature from a perspective you have never seen before. Fascinating landscape footage in high-quality HD technology, coupled with spectacular Cineflex aerial views, take us on a journey through the hitherto unknown blazes of colour of the Central European region and its inhabitants. We show you paradise on earth and demonstrate how climate and astronomy determine our life cycle. While seasons change, we visit several different European habitats that - in their diversity, are exemplary of a Central European region. Mountains, water, forests and meadows: we return to each of these habitats at different times of the year and show how the rhythm of life of each of our protagonists follows nature's clock. The four seasons determine all of the coming and passing away; a highly complex interplay in the universe of life. We explore the wondrous worlds of the mysterious cycle of nature together with extraordinary people. Breathtaking landscapes enable us to experience the change of seasons at first hand.

programme.title: The most spectacular change of seasons - Spring
programme.desc: This film explores Central Europe and presents the nature from a perspective you have never seen before. Fascinating landscape footage in high-quality HD technology, coupled with spectacular Cineflex aerial views, take us on a journey through the hitherto unknown blazes of colour of the Central European region and its inhabitants. We show you paradise on earth and demonstrate how climate and astronomy determine our life cycle. While seasons change, we visit several different European habitats that - in their diversity, are exemplary of a Central European region. Mountains, water, forests and meadows: we return to each of these habitats at different times of the year and show how the rhythm of life of each of our protagonists follows nature's clock. The four seasons determine all of the coming and passing away; a highly complex interplay in the universe of life. We explore the wondrous worlds of the mysterious cycle of nature together with extraordinary people. Breathtaking landscapes enable us to experience the change of seasons at first hand.

programme.title: The Sun - Inferno in the Sky
programme.desc: On July 23rd, 2012, a massive eruption on the sun hurls a colossal cloud of solar matter into space. It’s the most severe sunstorm in 150 years. Fortunately, the Earth is not in the direct path of this solar ejection. But it’s only a matter of time before a violent solar storm hits us. When these clouds of charged matter reach our planet, they can wreak havoc in electrical systems.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: Madeira - Portugal's autonomous island in the Atlantic Ocean, is closer to the African coast than to the mother country Portugal, from which it is separated by about 900 kilometers. The island's name comes from Portuguese sailors who claimed the uninhabited isle for themselves in 1419. Madeira means wood and that was available in abundance. Almost the entire surface was covered by dense forest. Since 1982, two-thirds of the landscape has been protected.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The highest mountain range in Portugal is the Serra da Estrela. The episode embarks on a voyage of discovery to adventurous rock formations and villages steeped in tradition. The nature park is the largest protected area on the Iberian peninsula. In the mountain range we accompany the young scientist Ana Matos, who wants to breathe new life into old traditions, and cheese maker Maria Natália Lopes. She watches over more than 350 sheeps.

programme.title: Wild Alpine Rivers - Life in the Extreme
programme.desc: What would happen to the mountains without water? They would turn into deserts, devoid of life and vegetation. But there are very few mountains without water on our planet. They take care of this themselves, creating their life’s element and taking water directly from the sky by entrapping the clouds around them. This water then collects on the flanks of the mountains, where it turns from rivulets into rivers, that flow out into the oceans. Mountains and water are symbiotic, a cycle that keeps life on earth going. Mountain streams slowly move along meadows before, only moments later, turning into the spray of waterfalls or small mystic lakes. What kind of life can be found in and around this mysterious cosmos? We will investigate the world of the rare Danube salmon and be there to see the Danube bleak spawn. We will follow giant wels catfish into their hideouts, see great crested grebes on their underwater hunting. We go diving under the ice of frozen mountain streams and lakes, discovering life where none was thought possible.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Apes and Aliens
programme.desc: The Congo, mighty and deep like no other river - yet still a retreat and a habitat for several of our world's strangest animals. Our closest relatives live deep inside the dense jungles: three of the four giant ape species have made the Congo basin their home. Rich in extraordinary footage, the second episode of "Myths of the Congo" also presents exciting insights into one of the most mysterious and dangerous regions on earth.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Deep and Dangerous
programme.desc: The river that swallows all rivers - this is what the natives call it. In reality, the Congo, when considering its water masses, is the second largest and the deepest river in the world. At its source in the north of Zambia, it starts out as a mere trickle, but on its journey westwards it grows and grows, becoming ever mightier and with it, the animals, too: the shoebill stork hides in the dense papyrus. Metre-long pythons hunt for their prey in trees and huge hippos fight for power and respect in the water. To survive in the Congo, animals have to adapt to extreme conditions. Here, evolution has spawned unique creatures: fish with lungs, wings and those that go hunting on land. The Congo River feeds the second largest rainforest on earth. Here is the home of the forest elephant. Time and again, they are summoned to this one, magic place: the Dzanga Bay. Countless other forest dwellers join them. What makes this place so special?

programme.title: mareTV: Sardinia - Magical Island in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Sardinia is the second-largest island in the Mediterranean. The Sardin-ians themselves say it's a "continent for itself", a virtual world of its own, full of magic: A beach, gleaming in unreal pink shades, red corals protect against the evil eye and the inhabitants seem to remain forever young. On Sardinia, the owners of luxury yachts adopt sheep, fish have gold in their bellies and a giant mussel supplies the material for legendary sea silk. No one is surprised, that the Madonna goes on a sea cruise once a year.

programme.title: Bavarian Forest - Deep, Dark and Enchanted
programme.desc: After an unusual mass reproduction of bark beetles in the nineties, thousands hectares of old spruce forest were destroyed. Soon after, a new, healthier forest started to grow – a new primeval forest. Within a few years, in place of the former monoculture, a diverse forest developed, rich in spruces, ashes, beech and fir trees. Naturally, this diversity has in turn attracted new animal and plant species. Even lynx and otters returned and made Bavaria their home again.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Some risks on these autoroutes have natural causes: Extreme weather, avalanches and landslides. In some areas, the locals even believe that evil spirits kill travelers. But many of the dangers are man-made: robbers or terrorists lie in wait for travelers, and tough labor pressures, social hardship and greedy mass-transit businesses also cause tragic driving accidents around the world. In the 20th century alone, 35 million people died on roads worldwide - plus 1.5 billion injured! With the two-part "Death Roads - On the Road at the Limit," phoenix offers a documentary road movie along the world's most dangerous car routes.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Roads are much more than just gray strips of asphalt that allow us to travel and trade. For centuries they have been lifelines of mankind, full of stories and history - and in certain countries and areas they also hold great dangers, much human suffering and death. Documentary filmmaker Oliver G. Becker ventured onto dangerous roads in New Zealand, Scotland and Australia for phoenix.

programme.title: mareTV: Corsica - Fascinating Mountain World in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Corsica looks like an alpine landscape in the Mediterranean, an island with dramatic rock formations, romantic bays and proud inhabitants who see themselves first and foremost as Corsicans and only then as French. The Greeks in ancient times called the island Kalliste: the beautiful. We explore this fascinating mountain world in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland - Winter in the Swiss Alps
programme.desc: In the heart of Europe lies Switzerland. It’s a surprisingly big little country: small in area, but big on natural beauty. And, like its many languages and cultures, its scenic diversity is something really special, too: from mighty Alps, dense forests and lush green valleys, to mysterious moors and roaring waterfalls. Mediterranean lakes and craggy rock landscapes are all close together in one small geographical location. Switzerland has many wild faces – some familiar and some hidden. It’s a country that’s astonishingly rich in variety, wilderness and scenic wonder. Each episode of the series seeks to do justice to this diversity.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: A few thousand years ago, there were bare moraine ridges and barren meltwater valleys here. A landscape born in the last ice age, characterized by the edge of the Alps, gentle hills, moors, and lakes. And by cultural richness, not only on the islands in Lake Chiemsee, with their famous monasteries and castles. Long before King Ludwig II, the first people settled in the Chiemgau region. Finds of hunting weapons from the Neanderthal era prove that the land was inhabited even during the ice age, probably because there was plenty of game to hunt. During the Bronze Age, one of the most important trade routes from the mountains to the Alpine foothills passed through here. Then came the Celts and the Romans.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced "once-in-a-century" floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: Project Antarctica
programme.desc: Why don't you do something sensible? - Tim, Michael and Dennis have heard this sentence more than once since their school days when they professed their dream jobs: Artist, photographer, filmmaker. And they went on to say that some dreams had to remain dreams, that work didn't have to be fun, but above all that it had to pay enough and be safe. A few years later, the three are working on their joint feature film. They put all their eggs in one basket and are determined to invest two years of working time to achieve their goal. Unpaid. It's not just any goal: the three want to travel to Antarctica. They want to find out whether it is possible to reach even the most distant destinations if you only want to. With ten boxes full of equipment, they set off on the 14,000 km journey to Antarctica. And thus on the journey of a lifetime...

programme.title: North Macedonia: Between Traditional Dances and Mini Navy
programme.desc: Northern Macedonia emerged from being a once constituent republic of the former Yugoslavia. Anyone wishing to discover unknown worlds has every chance of finding them in this young Balkan country, full of imposing mountains, lakes of crystal-clear water, original villages and centuries-old customs. Nevertheless, Northern Macedonia, which borders Serbia in the north and Greece in the south, considered to be one of the poorest countries in Europe.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, The City and the Sea
programme.desc: The journey up the coast continues through Delaware to suburban New Jersey, and onwards into the heart of Manhattan. In Delaware, famous as a corporate tax haven, we visit a winery. In New York City we zip around with a bicycle courier and then head out to Long Island for oysters.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, Surf And Turf
programme.desc: New Hampshire has only 19 kilometers of coastline and short summers, all the more reason Shauna Fraser takes every opportunity to be by the sea. In the sheltered harbor of Rye, Shauna also targets inner attitude with yoga on a paddleboard.

programme.title: Model And The Bushmen, The
programme.desc: This is the story of an incredible adventure: a young woman from Norway moves into the wild and joins the last Bushmen hunters in Namibia. Every morning, the women set out to forage and the men sneak into the bush to hunt, carrying little else but homemade bows and arrows as they walk through the wilderness.

programme.title: Meteor Menace
programme.desc: On February 15th, 2013, out of the blue, a meteorite exploded in the earth’s atmosphere above the Russian region of Chelyabinsk. The event is a reminder of the ever-present 'Meteor Menace' and the need to understand more about these missiles from outer space.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.desc: Butterflies surely are the most fancied species inside the insect world. Their beautiful colouring and their graceful flight appeal to everyone. There are close to 4000 types of Butterflies – today many of them are endangered due to the loss of their habitat.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.sub-title: Children of the Sun - Wild Bees
programme.desc: Most people associate honey producing insects with the name “BEE“. Few realize that there are over 560 different species of bees - most of them live their lives “busy as a bee“ but some “abuse“ other insects and others are even known to be murderers. The film “Wild Bees” shows the incredible diversity and the stunning adaptations of our “BEES” to various habitats and diverse living conditions. Fascinating fights, sensational performances, imposing structures and colorful individuals – the world of “Wild Bees” offers all of this and more.

programme.title: Bavaria's Alpine Kingdom
programme.desc: There are sparkling palaces from ice and snow, like those found in a fairytale. The icy castles are the phenomenal work of Mother Nature but man had a hand in the magnificent stone castles of the region. The spectacular and histrionic mountains of the Bavarian Alps challenge wildlife and the people who live there and the rocky ramparts of this mountain kingdom are built of limestone and fossil rocks that tell of its origins beneath the sea. Millions of visitors from all over the world come to Bavaria every year to witness the mysticism of the landscape. Kings and Queens, tourist and locals, all are welcomed in the fantastic alpine kingdom. Early summer often comes with the threat of storms that bring floods that scour the land and threaten many creatures. But farmers risk these dangers to take their herds to the highest pastures, where they can graze on the sweetest flower-filled meadows. And later from the high-quality milk produced by their herds, the famers make highly prized cheese. Humankind lives among eagle owls, chamoix, wild cats, stoats and ravens up in these mountains.

programme.title: Alpine Lakes - Dark Depths and Icy Heights
programme.desc: This is a nature documentary, which leads us into the fascinating world of deep mountain lakes. We conquer ice palaces of unsuspected beauty. In the freezers, in which elves, fairies and mountain trolls once did their mischief, we move, using a special breathing technique and with special cameras in search of nocturnal hunters, whose eyes are equipped with residual light amplifying receptors.

programme.title: Broad City: Mushrooms

programme.title: Broad City: Witches
programme.desc: Abbi tuntee itsensä vanhaksi löydettyään harmaan hiuksen. Ilana käy seksiterapeutilla.

programme.title: Broad City: Florida
programme.desc: Abbi, Ilana, Eliot ja Bobbi matkustavat Floridaan siivoamaan Esther-mummin asuntoa.

programme.title: Broad City: House Sitting
programme.desc: Abbi, Ilana, Jaime ja Lincoln ovat kotivahtina. Ilana ja Lincoln määrittelevät suhteensa, ja Abbi tapaa erään miehen menneisyydestä.

programme.title: Broad City: Bed Bugs
programme.desc: Uusi, kaunis laukku kohottaa Abbin itsetuntoa työttömyyden keskellä. Ilana ja Jaimé kohtaavat painajaisen, jolta New Yorkissa ei voi välttyä.

programme.title: Broad City: Friendiversary
programme.desc: Tyttöjen ystävyysvuosipäivän juhlinta saa vaarallisen käänteen, kun he todistavat jotain karmaisevaa.

programme.title: Broad City: Stories
programme.desc: Juhlistaakseen Abbin 30-vuotissyntymäpäivää Abbi ja Ilana matkustavat läpi Manhattanin ja törmäävät matkalla sekä vanhoihin että uusiin ystäviin.

programme.title: Broad City: SheWork and S**t Bucket
programme.desc: Ilana yrittää tienata rahaa tällä kertaa perustamalla New Yorkin tupakoitsijoille ulkona sijaitsevan työtilan. Abbi ei hyväksy vuokranantajansa päätöstä kieltäytyä uusimasta asunnon putkistoa.

programme.title: Broad City: Bitcoin & the Missing Girl
programme.desc: Ilana vierailee vanhan heilansa luona ja vaatii tältä omaa Bitcoin-osuuttaan. Abbi vie pyykkinsä ensimmäistä kertaa pesulaan ja menettää suosikkipuseronsa.

programme.title: Broad City: Make the Space
programme.desc: Ilana saa selville hirvittävän salaisuuden Jaimésta. Abbi yrittää nousta vaatteiden viikkaajasta näyteikkunan somistajaksi Anthropologiessa.

programme.title: Broad City: Artsy Fartsy
programme.desc: Abbi saa kutsun hienoon taidetapahtumaan MoMa:an. Vuosipäiväänsä viettävät Ilana ja Lincoln keskustelevat parisuhteestaan.

programme.title: Broad City: Lost and Found
programme.desc: Tytöt tapaavat Ilanan kaukaisen, holokaustista selvinneen serkun ja vievät hänet drag queen -brunssille. Abbi kokeilee uutta tyyliä.

programme.title: Broad City: Shenanigans
programme.desc: Ilana värvätään hiusmalliksi. Abbin uusi ihastus ei pidä Abbia tarpeeksi kypsänä.

programme.title: Broad City: Sleep No More
programme.desc: Abbi ja Ilana vierailevat 'Sleep No More' -teatteriesityksessä, ja Abbi yrittää löytää sopivan hetken kertoakseen Ilanalle elämää mullistavista uutisistaan.

programme.title: Broad City: Along Came Molly
programme.desc: Abbi, Ilana ja Bevers myyvät Abbin New Yorkin -ajan tavaroita. Abbi hankkii liput Lil Waynen konserttiin ja tytöt tekevät pienen 'reissun'.

programme.title: Broad City: Broad City
programme.desc: Hyvästien aika.

programme.title: Broad City: What A Wonderful World
programme.desc: Ilana saa kuulla Lil Waynen salaisesta konsertista, joten hän suostuttelee Abbin lintsaamaan töistä ja etsimään mitä erikoisempia tapoja kerätä rahaa lippuihin. Tytöt eivät anna periksi oudoimmankaan haasteen edessä.

programme.title: Broad City: Stolen Phone
programme.desc: Abbi ja Ilana etsivät Facebookista miehiä huonolla menestyksellä ja päättävät lähteä tapaamaan miehiä IRL, eli oikeassa elämässä.

programme.title: Broad City: Working Girls
programme.desc: Ilana yrittää tienata ylimääräistä hanttihommissa. Abbi lupaa ottaa vastaan Jeremyn paketin, mutta missaa toimitusyrityksen ja päätyy tekemään kaikkensa saadakseen paketin käsiinsä.

programme.title: Broad City: The Lockout
programme.desc: Abbi pakenee tuholaistorjuntaa Ilanan luokse, mutta tytöt päätyvät kadulle Ilanan hukattua kotiavaimensa. Samana iltana onkin sopivasti Abbin ensimmäinen oma taidenäyttely.

programme.title: Broad City: P*$$Y Weed
programme.desc: Tyttöjen on aika kasvaa aikuisiksi. Abbi haluaa ostaa ruohoa ITSE, ja Ilana päättää vihdoin tehdä veroilmoituksen ilman vanhempien apua. Aikuistumispuuhissaan tytöt päätyvät polttelemaan ihan liikaa.

programme.title: Broad City: Fattest Asses
programme.desc: Abbi missaa elämänsä tilaisuuden töissä, ja Ilana tuntee itsensä yritysmaailman hännystelijäksi, joten tytöt päättävät ottaa ohjat omiin käsiinsä kattobileissä.

programme.title: Broad City: Hurricane Wanda
programme.desc: Abbi ja Ilana kokoontuvat kavereineen Abbin luokse hurrikaanin ajaksi. Valitettavasti seuraan liittyvät myös Bevers ja tämän sisko, joiden selvittämättömät kesäleiritraumat uhkaavat tulla Abbin ja Jeremyn orastavan ihastuksen tielle.

programme.title: Broad City: Destination: Wedding
programme.desc: Abbi ja Ilana seuralaisineen yrittävät epätoivoisesti ehtiä kaverinsa häihin, mutta oudot sattumat ja ripustautuvat vanhat kaverit tekevät matkalaisista selvää yksi kerrallaan.

programme.title: Broad City: Apartment Hunters
programme.desc: Abbi on innoissaan myytyään kuvitusta deittisovellukselle ja hän päättää hankkiutua eroon Beversista etsimällä uuden kämpän. Ilana puolestaan joutuu kohtaamaan kammottavan eksän päästäkseen kanavapaketin laskutusikeestä.

programme.title: Broad City: The Last Supper
programme.desc: Tytöt juhlivat Abbin synttäreitä hienossa ravintolassa. Abbi joutuu kasvokkain oman 'ällöttävyytensä' kanssa, ja Ilana kamppailee illallisen sivuvaikutusten kanssa.

programme.title: Broad City: In Heat
programme.desc: Abbi metsästää ilmastointilaitetta jäähdytelläkseen makuuhuoneensa menoa. Ilana puolestaan etsii sopivaa synttärilahjaa Lincolnille, jota ei tunne lainkaan.

programme.title: Broad City: Mochalatta Chills
programme.desc: Abbi saa viimein mahdollisuuden valmentaa asiakasta Soulsticessa, ja Ilana uppoutuu uuteen rooliin riistokapitalistina.

programme.title: Broad City: Wisdom Teeth
programme.desc: Abbilta poistetaan viisaudenhampaat, ja Ilana omistautuu ystävänsä hoivaamiselle - mikä tarkoittaa tietysti huumecocktailia ja heitteillejättöä.

programme.title: Broad City: Knockoffs
programme.desc: Abbi ja Jeremy pääsevät vihdoin tositoimiin ja Abbi saa yllätyksen. Ilana koluaa sillä aikaa äitinsä kanssa New Yorkin alamaailmaa käsilaukkujen toivossa.

programme.title: Broad City: Hashtag FOMO
programme.desc: Ilanan paitsi jäämisen pelko saa tytöt metsästämään täydellisiä bileitä. Abbista paljastuu jännittävä, surrealistinen salaisuus, joka jättää Ilanan sanattomaksi.

programme.title: Broad City: The Matrix
programme.desc: Abbi ja Ilana toteavat olevansa netin orjia ja päättävät irrottautua verkosta päiväksi. Rullaluistelu, koirahäät ja hätätilanne saavat tytöt kuitenkin kaipaamaan älypuhelimiaan.

programme.title: Broad City: Citizen Ship
programme.desc: Porukka juhlii Jaimen uutta kansalaisuutta veneellä. Bevers johdattaa Abbin ja Ilanan ansaan lupauksilla ilmaisesta viinasta, joten Lincoln ja Jaime jäävät kahden yrityslakimiesten keskelle.

programme.title: Broad City: Kirk Steele
programme.desc: Abbi saa selville salaisuuden Treyn menneisyydestä ja käyttää tietoa hyväkseen työpaikalla. Ilana jakaa viisauttaan seuraavalle sukupolvelle.

programme.desc: Abbi ottaa asiakseen palauttaa julkkisihastuksensa takin. Ilana ihastuu tyttöön, jossa on jotain ihmeen tuttua.

programme.desc: Abbi ja Ilana kohtaavat suuren vaatekriisin matkallaan ystävänsä taidenäyttelyyn. Samalla he etsivät epätoivoisesti yleistä vessaa.

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Hot Rodeja ja biisonipihvejä
programme.desc: Mikään ei hidasta burgerimiehiä, paitsi Hot Rod -festivaalit, Miss Pin up -kisat ja liian pienet hevoset! Horisontissa näkyy jo Texas, mutta sitä ennen käydään biisoniranchilla.

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Tykypäivät Texasissa
programme.desc: Akseli ja Ossi kutsutaan Dallas Starsin NHL-treeneihin puhumaan oikeasta ravinnosta. Tankkauksen kanssa ei leikitä, sillä Markkasen Laurikin on kaupungissa. Mutta missä on JJ?

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Rajakaupungin rosvot
programme.desc: Akseli ja Ossi herättävät kauhua golf-kentällä ja syövät enemmän tacoja kuin Texasin laki sallii. Raja tulee lopulta vastaan ja pakoautoa on vaihdettava. Arkansas, hoi! Täältä tullaan!

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Kovaa virtaa Mississippi!
programme.desc: Amerikan halki iskevät Burgerimiehet käyvät Arkansasissa pitsalla, burgerilla, pastalla ja kylvyssä. Matka jatkuu pää märkänä Memphisiin onkimaan Tennesseen tuoreinta kissakalaa.

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Sweet home Alabama ja Nashville, Tennessee
programme.sub-title: Sweet home Alabama ja Nashville, Tennessee
programme.desc: Mestarileipurit Akseli ja Ossi vaivaavat Alabamassa. Kun munkit on nähty, siirrytään naapuripitäjän puolelle Nashvilleen Mikael Granlundin ravintoterapeuteiksi.

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Viimeiset burgerit
programme.desc: Akseli Herlevi ja Ossi Lahtinen lähestyvät Atlantin valtamerta. Matkaa on takana tuhansia maileja ja edessä enää yksi osavaltio, vieraanvaraisuudestaan kuuluisa Georgia. Kausi päättyy.

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Kaukoidän kutsu
programme.desc: Uusi kausi alkaa! Burgerimiehet Akseli Herlevi ja Ossi Lahtinen singahtavat Aasian kiertueelle uusien street food-herkkujen perässä. Karavaani starttaa Japanin pääkaupungista Tokiosta. Kotimainen ruokareality. (42')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Isona Japanissa
programme.desc: Akseli ja Ossi ottavat haltuun Japanin keisarillisen Kioton teeseremonian kautta. Kimonot lepattavat, ramen roihuaa, munakasta menee ja luotijuna laulaa, kun Burgerimiesten Aasian kiertue jatkuu. Kotimainen ruokareality. (42')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Samuraiden kosto
programme.desc: Akseli ja Ossi paljastavat miekkansa Japanin Osakassa. Hodariympyrä sulkeutuu ja nyytit käyvät tulikuumina, kun burgerimiehet saavat syntymäpäivävieraan japanilaisen kulttuurin huipulta. Kotimainen ruokareality. (42')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Sakeaa menoa Kobessa
programme.desc: Akseli ja Ossi maistelevat sake-panimon tyhjäksi ja syövät Koben härät. Varpusparvi haastaa Ossia, mutta periksi ei anneta. Viimeinen juhla-ateria Japanissa vedetään tappiin asti. Kotimainen ruokareality. (41')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Pöytä Koreaksi
programme.desc: Akseli ja Ossi iskevät ginsengin voimalla Korean BBQ:n kimppuun Etelä-Korean Busanissa. Ikonisesta mummotunnelista löydetään mahtavat herkut ja tilaisuudesta otetaan vaari lasillisella sojua. Kotimainen ruokareality. (42')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Soulin sankarit
programme.desc: K-pop veteraanit Akseli ja Ossi kutsutaan valtiovierailulle Etelä-Korean pääkaupunkiin Souliin. Ohjelmaan kuuluu kanalan tyhjennys, Aasian hitain munaleipä ja laiton jokiristeily. Kotimainen ruokareality. (42')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Phukettimatka Thaimaassa
programme.desc: Uhanalaiset thaimaannorpat Akseli ja Ossi saapuvat pakettimatkalle Phuketiin. Pakettiin kuuluu banaanilettujen lisäksi runsaasti lihaa, kalaa ja kasviksia sekä normaalit ruokajuomat. Kotimainen ruokareality. (42')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Monta yötä Bangkokissa
programme.desc: Burgerimiehet Akseli ja Ossi raivaavat tiensä läpi Bangkokin öisten kujien. Kaikki syödään mitä vastaan tulee, mukaan lukien sonninjormakeitto, naudan ikenet ja peräkärryllinen chiliä. Kotimainen ruokareality. (42')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Hyvää huomenta Vietnam!
programme.desc: Burgerimiehet Akseli ja Ossi vetävät keittoa Vietnamissa niin innokkaasti että joutuvat Saigonille. Riisinhallinta onnistuu ja perinteinen vietnamilainen munakahvi piristää! Kotimainen ruokareality. (42')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Sokka irti Singaporessa
programme.desc: Burgerimiesten Aasian kiertue huipentuu Singaporeen, jossa ajetaan tandemilla päätyyn asti. Matkaoppaana toimii Singapore Sling ja listalta valitaan kaikki kertaa kaikki. Sarja päättyy. Kotimainen ruokareality. (42')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Säpinää Seattlessa
programme.desc: Uusi kausi alkaa! Burgerimiehet Akseli Herlevi ja Ossi Lahtinen jyräävät Amerikan halki uusien street food -herkkujen perässä. Eeppinen reissu käynnistyy Tyynen meren rannalta Seattlesta.

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Pöhinää Portlandissa
programme.desc: Akseli ja Ossi taistelevat villien tonnikalojen kanssa ja iskevät Oregonin street food skeneen kuin miljoona volttia. Mikään ei pysäytä burgerimiehiä, paitsi nälkä ja jano!

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Kohti Suurta Suolajärveä
programme.desc: Akselin ja Ossin pekoninhuuruinen road trip kohti itää jatkuu uusissa osavaltioissa. Idaho saa pitää perunansa, sillä Utahissa odottavat kaikkien aikojen hodari-överit!

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Kalliovuorten kuninkaat
programme.desc: Akseli ja Ossi testaavat off road -taitojaan ja tekevät valtiovierailun miljardöörien Aspeniin. Kalliovuorten jälkeen grillataan ja heilutellaan melaa Coloradon koskissa.

Mark Bowe ja hänen ammattitaitoinen käsityöläisporukkansa hyödyntävät uusiokäytössä vanhoja latoja ja mökkejä. He käyttävät puuta ja muita materiaaleja upeiden, nykyaikaisten kotien luomiseen. Yhdysvallat 2019

programme.title: Romuaittojen aarteet

programme.title: Kopioitu Telsu.fi:stä

programme.desc: Natumbren räjähdyksen jälkeen Blakea syytetään laittomien aseiden kaupasta. Alexis löytää todisteen, että Sean sai Jessen palaamaan Denveriin, jotta Jesse voisi suostutella Karenin pitämään Adamin vauvan.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Dana yrittää epätoivoisesti vakuuttaa Adamin siitä, kuinka paljon hän haluaa heidän poikansa. Hän sanoo, että jos he olisivat taas rakastava pariskunta, tuomari puoltaisi heitä.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Adamia ei enää epäillä poikansa kidnappaamisesta, kun Leslie soittaa hänelle ja sanoo, että Sean vei vauvan ja pitää häntä vankina.

programme.title: Dynasty

programme.title: Dynasty

programme.title: Dynasty

programme.title: Dynasty

programme.title: Dynasty

programme.title: Dynasty

programme.title: Forensic Files: Nursery Crimes
programme.desc: An investigation of a pediatrician, prompted by the mysterious death of one of her patients, leads to a Texas hospital where the pediatric mortality rate is higher than at any hospital in the country.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Lasting Impression
programme.desc: When the decomposed body of a teenage girl is discovered, police have no clues to her identity. To solve the case, investigators turn to bug larvae found on the body and a tiny wad of chewing gum found near the victim's body.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Foundation of Lies
programme.desc: Police suspect Dr. John "Jack" Boyle in the disappearance of his wife, Noreen, when he signs mortgage papers for a new house with a woman pretending to be his spouse. The police later find Noreen's body in the basement of Dr. Boyle's new house.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Vows
programme.desc: Survivors of Nazi atrocities recognized Archbishop Trifa, former head of the Romanian Orthodox Church in America, as having directed a bloody attack against Jews during World War II. He was deported in 1984 and died three years later.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Broken Promises
programme.desc: When a popular gym teacher is found dead of what appears to be an accidental gunshot wound, his family is suspicious. A tape recorded by the victim just before his death tells the true story of his strange marriage and his wife's insatiable greed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Time Will Tell
programme.desc: In this international case of extortion, murder and stolen identities, scam-artist Albert J. Walker assumes the identity of co-worker Ronald Platt. Platt later turns up dead in an ocean with an anchor tied around his torso.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Second Shot at Love
programme.desc: When heart surgeon Darryl Sutorius is found dead in the basement of his upscale Cincinnati home, police assume he committed suicide. Further investigation reveals that his new wife Della has a history of violence and an insatiable desire for money.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Journey to Justice
programme.desc: 6-year-old Nicole Rae Walker was killed in a hit-and-run in her Ft. Lauderdale neighborhood. The prosecutor combines the talents of an accident reconstruction expert with a video specialist to create a graphic demonstration of the moment of impact.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Video Diary
programme.desc: When convenience store employee Wanda Mason is found dead, investigators find the entire murder has been caught on the store's security camera. But the image of the killer is so degraded it seems impossible to positively identify him.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Knowledge
programme.desc: Police investigate a missing college girl and discover her double life: attending school by day and working as a call-girl by night. Her body is found and investigators find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Missing in Time
programme.desc: A woman is reported missing after a fight with her husband. Police suspect a man who reported a fire in his car. Two tiny drops of blood are found in the interior. Finally, a tiny clue inside the suspect's watchband helps solve the case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Missing Pearl
programme.desc: In 1991, Maine resident Pearl Smith goes missing after an argument with her husband, Bill Bruns. When investigators find a blood trail that leads to the couple's basement, police are sure they'll find the victim's body.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Man's Best Friend?
programme.desc: In 1989, 4-year-old April Loveless was found dead in the backyard of her Texas home. Her parents told police that she was attacked and killed by wild dogs. Investigators did not agree.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hand Delivered
programme.desc: In 1995, San Diego police are baffled by a pair of hands found in a dumpster. Through further investigation, they determine that the hands are those of missing person Don Hardin.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fire Dot Com
programme.desc: In 1996, a federal agency ruled that Terri Strickland had intentionally set the fire that killed her 17-month-old son, Josh Hinson. Using the then-emerging resources of the internet, Strickland undertook her own investigation.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Mistaken For Dead
programme.desc: In 1988, when a patient dies unexpectedly in the office of California neurologist Richard Boggs, police begin what they think will be a routine investigation. Soon they uncover a bizarre story of corpse stealing, fake identity and sexual perversion.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Frozen Evidence
programme.desc: One investigator's quick thinking helps him capture a shoe impression made in snow before the evidence melts away. The shoe leads investigators to Peter Benedict and Frank Lanoue, who are convicted of aggravated assault and robbery.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Soft Touch
programme.desc: In 1992, 22-year-old Dawn Bruce is brutally murdered in her Virginia apartment. Investigators notice a blood smear on a pillow case that appears to have been made by one of the killer's fingers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Disappearance
programme.desc: In 1981, 6-year-old Cassie Hansen disappeared from her Minnesota church during an evening service. After receiving a tip that an older man was seen carrying a small person, police found Cassie's body in a dumpster.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Photo Finish
programme.desc: Professional photographer Charles Rathbun claims model Linda Sobek died during a consensual sexual encounter gone wrong, but Sobek's corpse and digital imaging tell a more sinister story.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Whodunit
programme.desc: In 1998, a Maryland murder mystery performance turns into a real whodunit when the badly burned body of Stephen Hricko is discovered in his hotel room.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Horse Play
programme.desc: In 1980, Michigan resident Shannon Mohr died in what her new husband, David Davis, reported to be a horseback riding accident. After her death, Shannon's family reported that Davis seemed far from grief-stricken.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Treads and Threads
programme.desc: For 15 months, a serial killer was strangling prostitutes in Florida, then taunting police by leaving the bodies in plain sight. The only clues were a tire impression and some threads.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Killer's Cattle Log
programme.desc: When police in the Great Plains are called about a dead body, a background check on the victim leads them into a bizarre web of homeless drifters, cattle auctions and bad checks — all fronted by elderly couple Ray and Faye Copeland.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skin of Her Teeth
programme.desc: In 1994, a human skull retrieved from an Ohio pond reveals a ghastly crime. Markings on the skull indicate that the victim had been stabbed multiple times and that the teeth had been removed with needle-nose pliers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Line of Fire
programme.desc: In 1996, when a fundamentalist group begins robbing banks near Spokane, authorities know immediately that they are dealing with experienced criminals.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bad Blood
programme.desc: In rural Canada, Dr. John Schneeberger is accused of sedating and sexually assaulting one of his female patients and his step daughter. DNA tests demonstrate that the doctor is innocent, but the patient insists that he sedated and raped her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pure Evil
programme.desc: In the search for the killer of two Texas teenagers, a behavioral profile led to suspect Jason Massey. Hard science proved the profile was correct, and Massey was executed by lethal injection on April 3, 2001.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Root of All Evil
programme.desc: A suspect's former lover comes forward with a fantastic tale of murder, mutilation and cremation. But there's no way to test the story's validity — until a plant pathologist and a dendrochronologist conduct tests where the cremation supposedly occurred.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Where the Blood Drops
programme.desc: Susie Mowbray was charged in her husband's death. Her son was so convinced of her innocence that he enrolled in law school, studied all of the evidence and, eventually, discovered the truth of what really happened between his parents.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Punch Line
programme.desc: In 1994, Rhoda Nathan was found murdered in a Cincinnati hotel room. When hotel employee Elwood Jones visited the emergency room with an infected hand, which he said was cut on a dumpster, the doctor recognized the injury as something else.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sibling Rivalry
programme.desc: In 1991, San Francisco pornographer Artie Mitchell was murdered in his home. His brother and business partner, who was found near the scene carrying a rifle, later confesses to shooting Artie.The question is whether the shooting was premeditated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pastoral Care
programme.desc: In 1981, New York correctional officer Donna Payant disappeared and was later found in a landfill. The medical examiner not only identified the cause of death, but also found an important clue.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bagging a Killer
programme.desc: In 1999, 9-year-old Valiree Jackson vanished on her way to school near Spokane. Her father, Brad Jackson, reported the disappearance and the entire community started searching for her abductor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Trouble
programme.desc: In 1995, when off-duty Maine State Trooper Vicky Gardner is attacked by Steven Fortin during a routine stop, it triggers a chain of events which jumpstart a stalled murder case in New Jersey.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cats, Flies & Snapshots
programme.desc: When 19-year-old Lori Auker left her Pennsylvania home for work and never arrived, it took space-age technology, cat hairs and insects to pinpoint the woman's abductor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Naked Justice
programme.desc: When Leann Fletcher is found dead, investigators use blood spatter analysis and forensic computing to find a motive for her murder: her husband, a prominent lawyer, was having an affair with judge Susan Chrzanowski.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Treading Not So Lightly
programme.desc: By using techniques she saw on forensic science TV shows, a mother determines who was responsible for the accident that permanently injured her 4-year-old daughter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Treading Not So Lightly
programme.desc: By using techniques she saw on forensic science TV shows, a mother determines who was responsible for the accident that permanently injured her 4-year-old daughter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shopping Spree
programme.desc: When a woman and her daughter didn't return home from shopping, her husband directed police to a nearby mall. The child's body was found, but there was no sign of the wife.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shopping Spree
programme.desc: When a woman and her daughter didn't return home from shopping, her husband directed police to a nearby mall. The child's body was found, but there was no sign of the wife.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Forever Hold Your Peace
programme.desc: When Chris Ochoa confessed to the 1988 rape and murder of Nancy DePriest, the case was closed. 8 years later, Achim Marino confessed to the same crime. Can DNA evidence identify the real perpetrator?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Forever Hold Your Peace
programme.desc: When Chris Ochoa confessed to the 1988 rape and murder of Nancy DePriest, the case was closed. 8 years later, Achim Marino confessed to the same crime. Can DNA evidence identify the real perpetrator?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Reel Danger
programme.desc: When two boys are brutally attacked, investigators rely on evidence fished out of a nearby pond. It became the first case where diatom analysis was used to place a suspect at the scene of the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Reel Danger
programme.desc: When two boys are brutally attacked, investigators rely on evidence fished out of a nearby pond. It became the first case where diatom analysis was used to place a suspect at the scene of the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Who's Your Daddy
programme.desc: In 1988, the body of a young woman was discovered in an Ohio river. Most of the evidence had been washed away, but the victim's 6-year-old son unwittingly told investigators all they needed to know — without saying a word. The clue was in his genes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Who's Your Daddy
programme.desc: In 1988, the body of a young woman was discovered in an Ohio river. Most of the evidence had been washed away, but the victim's 6-year-old son unwittingly told investigators all they needed to know — without saying a word. The clue was in his genes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Alibi
programme.desc: In 1991, a high school girl vanished after attending a party. The prime suspect had two alibi witnesses for the night she disappeared. A solid alibi can often overcome circumstantial evidence, but forensic evidence is another matter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Alibi
programme.desc: In 1991, a high school girl vanished after attending a party. The prime suspect had two alibi witnesses for the night she disappeared. A solid alibi can often overcome circumstantial evidence, but forensic evidence is another matter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Purr-fect Match

programme.title: Naked Attraction Ruotsi
programme.desc: Yllätys. 44-vuotiaalle Lindalle iällä ja sukupuolella ei ole merkitystä kumppanin valinnassa. Hän etsii spontaania ja hauskaa ihmistä, jonka kanssa laulaa karaokea. Ruotsi 2023

programme.title: Kopioitu Telsu.fi:stä
programme.desc: The "Curse" Begins at Christmas. Harrisin perhe tapettiin New Yorkissa jouluna 1989. Juuri kun asiat alkavat näyttää normaalilta, kauhu tulee takaisin ja "kirous" kestää 10 vuotta. Vuosina 1989-1999 rauhallisen Drydenin pikkukylän tiivis yhteisö järkkyi, kun alueella tapahtui useita murhia. Vähitellen alkoi liikkua huhuja, että pittoreski kylä on kirottu. Rikossarjassa mennään ajassa taaksepäin kylmäävään ajanjaksoon ja tarkastellaan tapahtumia muun muassa viranomaisten avulla. Yhdysvallat 2017

programme.title: Houkuteltu tappamaan
programme.desc: Tulinen rakkaussuhde baarin omistajan ja tarjoilijan välillä johti kohtalokkaaseen videolle nauhoitettuun murhaan Floridan Daytona Beachilla 1989. Mitä kaikkea epätoivoinen ihminen on valmis tekemään rakkauden vuoksi? Nämä tositapahtumiin perustuvat murhatarinat kertovat synkän totuuden. Kun pariskunta tekee murhan, poliisi selvittää, kuka manipuloi ketä. Miten ja miksi viettelijät manipuloivat jonkun tappamaan puolestaan? Yhdysvallat 2023

programme.title: Kova laki: Erikoisyksikkö
programme.desc: Rikosdraamasarja kertoo seksuaalirikoksia tutkivan poliisiosaston toiminnasta New Yorkissa. Yhdysvallat 2022

programme.title: Kova laki: Erikoisyksikkö
programme.desc: Rikosdraamasarja kertoo seksuaalirikoksia tutkivan poliisiosaston toiminnasta New Yorkissa. Yhdysvallat 2022

programme.title: Ratkaisevat rikostallenteet
programme.desc: Run With It. Sieppaukset, murtautumiset, villit autojahdit ja muut rikokset keräävät miljoonia katselukertoja, mutta näiden rikosten takana olevia tarinoita ei usein koskaan kerrota. Tämä sarja vie katsojat järkyttävimpien rikosten syövereihin. programme.title: Jade Fever

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Tiimi löytää kauden parhaan jadelohkareen, mutta on vaarassa heikentää sen arvoa, kun he yrittävät leikata kaikki halkeamat pois.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudian poika Justin osoittaa, että hän osaa löytää jadea, kun taas Scrappy Larry, Robin ja Josh kamppailevat hinaamaan rikkinäisen autonsa Wolverinelle.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Huonot tulokset pakottavat Robinin ja Justinin viimeiseen yritykseen etsiä jadekiviä pelastaakseen kauden, kun taas Scrappy Larry kiirehtii muuntamaan dieselillä toimivan säiliön.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudian hanke majoittaa työryhmä Jade Cityyn vaarantuu, kun saostussäiliö vuotaa juomaveteen.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Kylmän sään saapuessa aikaisin ja velkojen kasaantuessa miehistö työntää, vetää ja raahaa mammuttimaisen ja mahdollisesti kauden pelastavan lohkareen leirille.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Kun vuoden lupaavinta lohkaretta työstetään Wolverinella, Josh ja R2 kolaroivat rekka-autonsa, ja Claudia tiimineen jäävät ymmälleen.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Kilpailu on käynnissä, jotta Wolverinen leiristä päästään pois ennen kuin kaikki jää lumen alle.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudia joutuu ajamaan kiviautoa, kun hänen miehistönsä kamppailee kivistä polkua ylös Wolverinen vuorenhuipulla sijaitsevaan leiriin.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Jännitteet nousevat pintaan, kun Claudia, Robin ja miehistö yrittävät saada ihmisiä ja varusteita syrjäiseen leiriinsä.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudia ja Robin yrittävät tehdä vaikutuksen uusiin liikekumppaneihinsa, mutta ensimmäiset päivät uudella alueellaan Bullion Creekissä ovat turhauttavia.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Kauden ensimmäinen valtava lohkare tuodaan leiriin ja työstetään.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Justin haluaa ostaa alueen törmättyään uskomattomaan jadelöytöön, mutta muut kaivostyöläiset löytävät paikalle.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudian uusi parisuhde kärsii, kun Justin ja miehistö eivät pysty siirtämään jättimäistä lohkaretta, joka voi olla omaisuuden arvoinen.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Riideltyään liikekumppaneidensa kanssa Claudia ja Robin kilpailevat aloittaakseen uudelleen kaivostoiminnan Wolverinessa, mutta heidät pysäytetään yllättävän esteen vuoksi.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Miehistö yrittää saada Dynastyn jadelouhoksen käyntiin, vaikka laitteet eivät toimi.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Justin ja Mike taistelevat murtumia ja toisiaan vastaan yrittäessään todistaa menetelmänsä kärsimättömille sijoittajille.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Alan palaa Kiinasta ja antaa Justinille ja Mikelle kylmän annoksen todellisuutta jadesta, jota he louhivat.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Justin ja Mike puskivat lumen ja jäätyneen veden läpi päästäkseen mahdollisesti arvokkaalle jadelaatalle - Suurelle saaliille.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Talvi saapuu Dynastyyn, ja miehistö kamppailee kaivostoiminnasta viimeiseen mahdolliseen minuuttiin asti.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Kaivoskauttaan yksin rahoittava Claudia, joka on päättänyt aloittaa kaivostoiminnan kuukautta aikaisemmin, joutuu miettimään strategiaansa uudelleen, kun lumi ja korkea vesitaso pysäyttävät työt.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Robin seuraa vaistoaan vanhalla alueella sijaitsevaan uuteen paikkaan, kun taas Joshin korkeat odotukset ja arvaamattomuus koettelevat Garyn kärsivällisyyttä.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Guy kamppailee kaivinkoneen kanssa massiivisen löydön paljastamiseksi, kun taas Joshin tyytymättömyys asemaansa miehistössä saa perheriidat kiehumaan.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Miehistö hoitaa vaarallisen talteenoton Turnagain-joen yläpuolisilla rannoilla.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Mahdollisen miljoonan dollarin arvoisen löydön leikkaaminen keskeytyy, kun vanha laite pettää.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Dynastyn jättimäisen jadelinssin leikkaaminen alkaa vihdoin, mutta suuret halkeamat murtavat linssiä.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Sadekuurot uhkaavat miehistön turvallisuutta ja lopettavat louhinnan Pit 3:ssa. Josh saa tilaisuuden todistaa kaivinkonetaitojaan, mutta rikkoutuminen koettelee hänen kärsivällisyyttään.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Tärkeä jaden ostaja ei ole vaikuttunut Pit 3:n linssistä, joten Claudia joutuu tekemään vaikean päätöksen, joka tuottaa pettymyksen miehistölle.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Wolverinen leirin pakkaaminen muuttuu painajaiseksi, kun kuumuus, sairaudet ja metsäpalo iskevät miehistön päälle.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Raaka vaellus uudelle kaivospaikalle erottaa perheenjäsenet toisistaan ja Josh on murtumaisillaan.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudia haluaa kovasti aloittaa uuden kaivospaikan rakentamisen, mutta edistystä jarruttaa joukko epäonnisia tapahtumia heidän vanhalla kaivosleirillään Wolverinessa.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Leirin pienet ylellisyydet piristävät tyytymätöntä miehistöä, ja yllättävät vierailijat herättävät Claudian toiveet tulevaisuudestaan 2 Milessa.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Gary ja Josh eivät palaa rutiininomaiselta polttoaineenhakumatkaltaan, ja kairasydämet herättävät epäilyksiä 2 Milen jadelinssien laadusta.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Miehistö tekee lopulta suuren löydön, mutta talven saapuessa Claudia on huolissaan siitä, että suuri löytö on ehkä tullut liian myöhään.

programme.title: Jade Fever

programme.title: Handu pumpulla

programme.title: Handu pumpulla

programme.title: Handu pumpulla

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Veksi ja Fjalle lähtevät puolisoineen landelle kesää viettämään, vaikka Humallahti tai Oulunkyläkin varmaan jo riittäisi. Ulkohuussi hämmentää ja pelottaa, mutta onneksi tikanheitto ja kalastus ovat tuttua huttua stadilaisillekin.

programme.title: Handu pumpulla

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Fjallen sairaalareissu saa Veksin muistelemaan menneitä tavallistakin ponnekkaammin. Muisteloissa käydään läpi muun muassa Veksin hääpäivä, josta ei dramatiikkaa puuttunut. Nykypäivässä huoli ja murhe parhaasta kaverista on kova.

programme.title: Handu pumpulla

programme.title: Handu pumpulla

programme.title: Handu pumpulla

programme.desc: Carriesta tuntuu pahalta, koska Arthurilla ei ole ystäviä, ja rohkaisee Dougia tekemään jotain yhdessä Arthurin kanssa. Doug antaa vastahakoisesti Arthurin tulla mukaansa ja huomaa, että Carrie on hyvin kiitollinen. Todella kiitollinen.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Paternal Affairs
programme.desc: Dougin Sheila-täti (vieraileva tähti Brenda Vaccaro) tulee käymään erottuaan miehestään. Doug on kauhuissaan, kun Sheila-tätiin hullaantunut Arthur pyytää lupaa "riiata" tätä.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Art House
programme.desc: Dougin kärsivällisyys Arthuria kohtaan on käymässä vähiin, varsinkin sen jälkeen, kun Doug saa melkein potkut Arthurin takia tämän käytettyä hänen autoaan huonekalujen siirtämiseen. Raivostunut Doug kertoo Arthurille, mitä mieltä on tästä oikeasti.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Doug Out
programme.desc: Kun Arthur kuulee Dougin pilkkaavan itseään, Doug tuntee olonsa niin syylliseksi, että hän antaa Arthurille yhden rakkaista Mets-lipuistaan, jonka hän voitti, kun hänet nimitettiin IPS:n kuukauden kuljettajaksi.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Frozen Pop
programme.desc: Kun kylmä rintama valtaa Queensin, Arthur muuttaa kylmästä kellarista toisen kerroksen makuuhuoneeseen aivan Carrien ja Dougin viereen.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Surprise Artie
programme.desc: Carrie pyytää Dougia harhauttamaan isäänsä Arthuria, kun hän koristee taloa yllätyssynttärijuhlia varten.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Work Related
programme.desc: Arthur aloittaa työt Carrien firmassa. Doug ja Deacon kilpailevat parhaasta kepposesta.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Papa Pill
programme.desc: Dougin käy Arthuria sääliksi, joten hän antaa tämän mennä cocktail-baariin viikoittaisten vanhusten tanssien sijaan. Asiasta kuultuaan Carrie raivostuu ja jättää isänsä hoidon Dougille. Pian Doug kuitenkin tulee katumapäälle.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Ticker Treat
programme.desc: Kun Doug suutuspäissään uhmaa Arthurin halloween-kieltoa, Arthur päätyy sairaalaan. Deacon murehtii, että Kirby saattaa olla gay, koska poika valitsi tytöille suunnatun asun.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Lyin' Hearted
programme.desc: Sydänleikkaukseen valmistautuva Arthur pyytää Carrieta ja Dougia hakemaan hänen unimaskinsa. Maskia etsiessään Carrie tekee mielenkiintoisia löytöjä. Doug tutustuu sairaalassa omituiseen vieraaseen ja saa pian katua sitä.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Life Sentence
programme.desc: Kun Carrie ehdottaa henkivakuutusta, Doug huolestuu, että Carrie saattaa kuolla ja jättää hänet hoitamaan Arthuria. Deacon, Spence ja Danny keksivät viihdettä katsomalla Arthurin arkisia toimia Dougin asentaman kameran kautta.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Shrink Wrap
programme.desc: Arthur vierailee psykiatrin luona ja kokee takauman epämiellyttävästä kohtaamisesta isänsä kanssa, joka saattaa tarjota selityksen Arthurin ätäkkään persoonallisuuteen.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Arthur, Spooner
programme.desc: Kun Carrie on väliaikaisesti yövuorossa, Doug hakee seuraa Arthurista ja alkaa lämmetä tälle.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Queens'bro Bridge
programme.desc: Arthur ja hänen velipuolensa Skitch tapaavat, kun Doug järjestää heille kohtaamisen Skitchin miehittämällä tiemaksuasemalla.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Frigid Heirs
programme.desc: Arthur voittaa 2 500 dollaria bingossa ja suostuu jakamaan voittonsa Dougin ja Carrien kanssa. Valitettavasti Arthur kokee asiakseen päättää, miten heidän tulee käyttää osuutensa.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Switch Sitters
programme.desc: Vahdittuaan Deaconin ja Kellyn lapsia lukemattomia kertoja Dougista ja Carriesta tuntuu, että Deaconin ja Kellyn pitäisi tehdä vastapalvelus ja vahtia Arthuria silloin tällöin.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku
programme.desc: Arthur yrittää myydä viereisensä hautapaikan Spencelle, mutta päätyykin myymään sen Spencen äidille, Veronicalle. Dougin uudella jakelureitillä oleva mies avaa oven pelkkään pyyhkeeseen pukeutuneena.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Foe: Pa
programme.desc: Dougin täytyy paikata isän ja tyttären välit, kun Carrie menettää mahdollisuuden työpaikkaan kiinteistövälitysfirmassa Arthurin temppuilun takia.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku
programme.desc: Carrien ollessa vuoteenomana Doug lupautuu Arthurin pariksi shuffleboard-kilpailuun, mutta hänen taitonsa eivät miellytä Arthuria. Carrie esittää sairautensa jatkuvan, jotta Holly laittaisi hänelle edelleen ruokaa.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Offtrack...Bedding
programme.desc: Joe intoilee pienoisjunamessuista niin paljon, ettei voi käyttää teatterilippuja, jotka Doug hankki hänelle ja hänen äidilleen. Niinpä Janet lähtee Arthurin kanssa, ja ystävyys puhkeaa kukkaan.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Cologne Ranger
programme.desc: Doug ei suostu antamaan periksi, kun Carrie inhoaa hänen uutta partavettään. Arthur opettaa Hollyn ja Spencen livahtamaan elokuviin.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Pour Judgment
programme.desc: Carrien epäilyksistä huolimatta Doug toteuttaa vanhan unelmansa baarimikoksi ryhtymisestä, mutta pian hän tajuaa, ettei se ole samanlaista kuin elokuvassa "Cocktail." Arthur hakee vanhuskeskuksen puheenjohtajaksi.

programme.desc: Doug alkaa hemmotella Carrieta saadakseen luvan lähteä kavereidensa kanssa Las Vegasiin. Arthur opettaa Spenceä laskemaan kortteja rikastuakseen hyväntekeväisyystapahtuman kasinoillassa.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Slippery Slope

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Inn Escapable
programme.desc: Dougin ja Carrien vierailu majataloon kehkeytyy ylivoimaisen hankalaksi. Samaan aikaan Arthurilla on oma romanttinen ongelmansa.

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Buggie Nights

programme.title: Kellarin kunkku: Get Away
programme.desc: Carrie ja Doug lähtevät viikonloppumatkalle Deaconin ja Kellyn kanssa. Kun he saavat vierekkäiset huoneet hotellissa, Heffernanit huomaavat nopeasti, että heidän parhaimmillaan ystävillään on erittäin aktiivinen seksielämä.
